tool.name: Biomni: Check Fda Drug Recalls
tool.description: Check for FDA drug recalls and enforcement actions.
tool.help:
**Biomni: Check Fda Drug Recalls**
Check for FDA drug recalls and enforcement actions.
Args: drug_name: Name of the drug to check classification: Optional filter by recall class ["Class I", "Class II", "Class III"] date_range: Optional date range for recalls
Returns: Formatted string with recall information
**Domain**: pharmacology **Function**: check_fda_drug_recalls
